_resolved: Source file arrived as ~/Downloads/' .mp4' (name mangled on download); confirmed as the muscle/PCOS take by transcript readback.
Registration number: not shown on screen. Handled at consultation.
Text placement follows the source footage's baked-in top-half graphics.
Doctor title card timing left to build_captions, which places it in a blank-top window.
Ghost preview text removed — the payload's space is now reserved with visibility:hidden instead of a 16%-opacity copy of the words.
auto_zone now requires the top band to be clear for a beat's whole life plus 8 frames either side. Partial clearance was letting captions sit over the burned-in graphics at each end.
Consequence of that rule on this clip: every answer beat is low, so the doctor title card moves to the top during its blank-top window rather than colliding with the captions.

The pinned three-fill palette (white / #FFB01F amber / #FF6F52 coral on a flat black stroke) is REVERTED. Niranjan reviewed it against pcos-insulin-resistance and pcos-walking and found it worse: too much black, and a bad small-font combination. Colour is back to palette.py's measured rotation.

The small italic lead that was previously pinned to cream on beats 6 and 9 is no longer pinned. palette.py's nearby_lead now contrast-checks its tint against the local background (APCA floor 45) instead of only nudging lightness, which is what had made the derived lead vanish on the parrot-green saree.

Niranjan rejected the low captions outright: the outline ('borderline'), the thin ladder rule under the payload, the two-tone lead+payload pairing, and the colours. All four are removed. Reference for what good looks like: pcos-insulin-resistance — one strong colour, huge type, no outline, clean ground.

MEASURED: inside the caption footprint there is NO flat colour that clears APCA against both ends of this footage — cream fails against the bright saree/bangles (worst 2.2) and forest/rust/chocolate fail against the black mic (worst 0.6). That is why a scrim is required here and was not on pcos-insulin-resistance, where the type sat on a clean wall.

Niranjan: colours must be VIBRANT, not cream. On the dark scrim the dark brand tones are unusable (forest 3.9 Lc, brick 18.8, rust 17.9) so the rotation uses their light-flipped counterparts at 55-99 Lc. The scrim itself is deep forest #0B2119 — the brand green, used as ground.

Niranjan: a caption is not owed to every sentence. Beats 4-7 are skipped because the burned-in graphic already names those exact benefits on screen. build_captions now supports "skip" per beat and reports any beat >=75% covered by a graphic as a skip candidate.
